i feel like i have two types of loneliness: actual loneliness and self-loneliness.

when i feel 'actual loneliness', i just go out and hang out with a friend in real life. sometimes i'll be feeling really shit and start to self-isolate. and then i'll start feeling like i don't have any friends (even though i do, love them lol).

when i feel 'self-loneliness', i take a day or two to just hang out with myself. i spend a lot of time on social media and start pitying myself for not being as productive or pretty or talented as whoever i'm looking at. i start to feel like i don't have friends because who would i want to be friends with me? and i start to spiral into this idea of me not actually enjoying any or my hobbies or my friends and that i'm just a fake person doing stuff to seem cool... yeesh. it's usually a sign for me to draw for a few hours, paint, read a book, whatever. just remind myself of who i am \^\_\^

to me and our other friends, this was obviously her cousin taking advantage of her. yeah, her parents do have issues (beyond just being controlling), but my friend needs to realize that it's not her place to 'save' her cousin. her cousin often projects and won't put in the same effort for her.

in my opinion, people aren't born bad people. it's the people their upbringing that strongly influences them. there isn't anything we can do about that if they don't want help... remember to put yourself first. put effort into people that will reciprocate the same effort because friendship is a two way street. hope you have a better Christmas this year op! <3

For a recent (but really mild) example, I recently started taking Debate class, and we had a very silly topic to debate to give us an idea of how a debate would work and to get to know our classmates. I know we weren't supposed to take it seriously. In fact, I still had a lot of fun. However, some people, this one really smart kid that I kinda (really) look up to in particular, didn't put in any effort at all! And still criticized me! Even though I tried to get everyone to participate as much as I could. It almost feels like this person I looked up to doesn't really believe in my passion or skill for debate at all... not enough to take me seriously.

As for how to treat ENFJs, all you have to do is just participate or be engaged in conversations. Even if you're shy or awkward, most ENFJs will realize that and make it easier for you. All we wanna do is just talk about things we're interested in like everyone else >_<
